BatteryReading.description:
One side's battery reading; ``read_at`` is the device-side reading time.

``millivolts`` is the raw value so a later discharge curve can recompute
``percent``; the percent is the reporting client's conversion.
BatteryReading.title: BatteryReading

DiagnosticUploadResponse.description: The stored package; an idempotent replay returns the identical body.
DiagnosticUploadResponse.title: DiagnosticUploadResponse

InsoleChangesResponse.description:
One page of changes ordered by ``revision``.

Pass ``next_cursor`` back as ``cursor``; it is returned on every page, also
the last one, and is opaque. ``has_more`` says whether to fetch again now.
InsoleChangesResponse.title: InsoleChangesResponse

InsoleHolder.description:
The terminal using the pair; present exactly while ``state`` is ``in_use``.

``terminal_name`` is the holder's name when it reported ``in_use``.
InsoleHolder.title: InsoleHolder

InsoleIdentity.description:
A node identity; it identifies the device and never authenticates it.

``kind`` + ``value`` name the device and are compared exactly as sent;
``provenance`` records how the value was derived and is not compared. A
``mac`` value must be uppercase hex octets joined by colons.
InsoleIdentity.title: InsoleIdentity

InsoleReportRequest.description: Any non-empty subset of the three independently merged groups.
InsoleReportRequest.title: InsoleReportRequest

ReportedInsoleState.description: States a report may set; ``retired`` is reached only by the retire route.
ReportedInsoleState.title: ReportedInsoleState

SubjectChangesResponse.description:
One page of changes ordered by ``revision``.

Pass ``next_cursor`` back as ``cursor``; it is returned on every page, also
the last one, and is opaque. ``has_more`` says whether to fetch again now.
SubjectChangesResponse.title: SubjectChangesResponse

SubjectEditableStatus.description: The statuses a terminal may set; MERGED and RESTRICTED are server-side.
SubjectEditableStatus.title: SubjectEditableStatus

SubjectExternalIdentifier.description: The active institution number, masked; look a number up with resolve.
SubjectExternalIdentifier.title: SubjectExternalIdentifier

SubjectIdentity.description: Identity downlinked to the institution's own terminals (D1); no contact.
SubjectIdentity.title: SubjectIdentity

SubjectNameSearchRequest.description: Exact lookup after NFKC, trimming and case folding; never a prefix match.
SubjectNameSearchRequest.title: SubjectNameSearchRequest

SubjectNameSearchResponse.description: ACTIVE and ARCHIVED matches, at most ``SUBJECT_NAME_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS``.
SubjectNameSearchResponse.title: SubjectNameSearchResponse

SubjectTagCreateResponse.description: ``conflict`` is true when the normalized name already names ``tag``.
SubjectTagCreateResponse.title: SubjectTagCreateResponse

TerminalCredentialResponse.description:
Long-lived terminal credentials returned by activation and refresh.

A refresh replayed inside ``refresh_replay_grace_seconds`` after rotation
returns the identical ``refresh_token``; ``access_token`` is freshly issued.
TerminalCredentialResponse.title: TerminalCredentialResponse

info.description: Institutional screening ingestion API; it does not provide disease diagnosis. Offline contract of existing FeetForcePlate routes; not proof of deployed gait-insole support. Endpoints and TLS profiles are injected by consumers.
info.title: FeetForcePlate Cloud API
